notes: All dimensions are millimetres; CSV preserves source decimal values.
Source blank-number drill-only thru_hole pads are classified as NPTH mechanical holes for this proposal; confirm in the final PCB.

RGB pads are source footprint placed on B.Cu, mirrored in X in top view. Socket pads are already normalized to top-view B.Cu; do not mirror them again. Confirm pin-1 and chain direction before routing.
C963206 lands follow LCSC/EasyEDA enlarged footprint, not the smaller copper lands drawn in manufacturer PDF.
CASE_ONLY sidewall openings must not be drilled in the PCB; full app x/y/z centers and bore axes define their sidewall planes.
SW2 and SW3 use C2762970 side-actuated switches with the button pointing toward the left sidewall.
PCB screw clearance remains Ø2.40 NPTH; Print06 lid uses resin self-tapping pilots, no inserts.
C49352235 uses two Ø3.00 NPTH pin passages plus two B.Cu SMT lands; the previous key Ø1.20 PTH solder pads are removed.
Integral lid switch retention ledge is 1.50 mm thick, with 14.10 square R0.15 openings at app y=18.60; these are CASE_ONLY, not PCB holes.
This is a mechanical placement reference only. No copper routing, net assignment, DRC or manufacturing release is supplied.
